intent_title: Agents design a named piece of work

slices.name: From a named piece of work to its design
slices.outcome: The product owner runs three plays on a business intent and gets a slice to test, a plan with one epic and one story for each feature, and an eval that no build is given; a check flags each build session that read the evals folder, and the flag is recorded in that build run's evidence.

features.name: /shape-slice writes the slice and its hidden file
features.one_line: From a business intent, /shape-slice writes one slice, its link to the intent and its hidden file, and no plan, epic, story or eval.

features.name: /shape-plan writes the plan, the epic and the stories
features.one_line: From a shaped slice, /shape-plan writes the intent's one plan file, one epic for the slice and one story for each feature.

features.name: /shape-eval writes the hidden eval
features.one_line: From the plan's epic and stories, /shape-eval writes the eval for the business intent in the plan's evals folder, where no builder reads.

features.name: The build is given the business intent, never the eval
features.one_line: A build is given the business intent, never the eval, and a check flags each build session that read the plan's evals folder.
